name: Gasthaus Alpenrose
beschreibung: The Gasthaus Alpenrose is situated in the Austrian province of Tyrol. Its traditional alpine interior provides a tranquil and welcoming atmosphere. Guests can look forward to straightforward and comfortable lodging in a scenic rural setting. The surrounding area is characterised by dense forests and striking mountain peaks. Amenities include an on-site restaurant and a rejuvenating sauna. The inn serves as a fantastic starting point for numerous hiking trails, with private parking available on the premises.
